detail: Both backends already apply extra via Object.assign and persist the full Decision JSON (file: decisions/<id>.json; sqlite: decisions.data blob), exactly how overridden_by/assumptions/provenance are stored. The export tree and migrate forward/reverse round-trip the full object, so the optional field survives migration with zero migration-layer changes — proven by a new round-trip test.
summary: Back-link rides the existing updateStatus(id, status, extra) path — no IDecisionStore interface change, no sqlite schema column
